## papers 3.1.0

### New

- **Web pages of entries**: `papers open --web KEY...`, `papers list
  --open-web`, and `papers file fetch --browser` for the entries whose PDF
  papers cannot download (#240).
- **More PDFs recognised by `papers add`**: the SICI DOIs of older articles
  (#238); the PII of older Elsevier articles, in the text or in the document
  info, also letter-spaced (#239, #241); the file names given by Nature,
  Science and, before about 2005, Elsevier (#243, #244, #245). Each gives a
  candidate DOI, checked against the title.

### Changes

- **A PDF that the library has already** is no longer left behind by
  `papers add` in mode `move`: when the entry has a file of the same content,
  the added file (and such files of `--attach`) is deleted. It is kept in the
  history: `papers undo` brings it back (#243).
- **The title check**: a title that differs from the text by a character or
  two (98 % similar) is accepted (#242), and a title that the text only cites
  is not: a PDF that starts with the references of the previous article was
  added as one of those references (#243, #245).
- **The library is no longer locked during downloads** and lookups by
  `papers add` and `papers file fetch` (except `--upgrade`) (#237).
